verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence notes that users can delete messages from the Teams client, and that deleted messages stay reachable through export APIs for up to 21 days, a fixed post-deletion window. That is a documented deletion behavior, but the pack shows no user or admin control over retention periods. missing for 10: configurable retention policies, user/admin control over retention duration, permanent or verified deletion controls, AI/Copilot data retention settings, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Messages deleted by users from the Teams client can be accessed using export APIs up to 21 days from the time of deletion.
